title: Proactive GPU margin orchestrator for interactive batching
creator: Aisha Patel
description: We need a runtime component that proactively manages GPU memory margins across weights, KV cache, and activations for low-latency interactive workloads that use continuous batching. The 'margin orchestrator' will maintain a moving horizon estimate of headroom, pre-reserve slice budgets for short bursts, and trigger lightweight reconfiguration (e.g., reduce KV prefetch, shift to smaller model quantization profile, or enable inline KV eviction) to preserve 95p latency SLO while maximizing utilization and minimizing cold-evictions. Scope: design estimator, admission control hooks, lightweight policy engine, telemetry, integration with scheduler and cache manager. Out of scope: changes to model shard placement or hardware provisioning. Success criteria: reduce latency SLO breaches due to memory churn by 70% in A/B test; reduce cold KV evictions by 40%; keep aggregate GPU utilization within 5% of baseline. Deliverables: design doc, simulation harness, mem-horizon estimator library, orchestrator runtime, e2e GitHub PR, feature toggle and observability dashboard panels.
comments: 2026-03-10 Aisha Patel: Initial scoping completed in sync with Scheduler and KV teams. Decided to target interactive chat workloads first (median seq len 256, tail seq up to 1024).

2026-03-11 Liam Chen: Pushed prototype for mem-horizon estimator to a feature branch. Uses trace-driven sliding-window forecast + short-term burst detector. Early sims show better retention vs static buffer.
2026-03-11 Design feedback (Maya Singh): prefer 'soft slice' terminology for pre-reserves to make UX clearer in console. Will add a UX row to observability for soft slice utilization.

2026-03-12 Eng review (Rowan Diaz): flagged fallback policy complexity. Agreed to implement three fallback actions in order: 1) reduce KV prefetch, 2) enable micro-quantized model variant (q4_0→q4_1), 3) evict least-recent-KV-shards. Added instrumentation points to measure each action's latency and quality delta.
2026-03-12 Performance note (benchmark): baseline 95p token latency 52ms; with orchestrator in simulation 95p 47ms and cold-eviction events reduced by 45% for mixed-tenant traces.
2026-03-13 Security (Avery Knox): no new secrets, but will add audit event for pre-reserve and eviction actions. security_review_required set to false but will include audit log acceptance criteria.
2026-03-13 Product (Diego Morales): acceptable customer impact and rollout path agreed. Feature behind runtime-1.21 toggle and opt-in dedicated capacity beta for first customers.
acceptance_criteria: Design doc reviewed and approved by Runtime and KV teams
Simulation harness reproduces customer trace and shows >=40% reduction in cold-KV evictions
Orchestrator feature flag gated, end-to-end integration tests pass, and dashboard panels show soft-slice metrics (utilization, reclamation events)
Canary rollout on dedicated capacity with telemetry demonstrating <=5% regression in token throughput and >=70% reduction in SLO breaches caused by memory churn
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Estimator mispredictions cause unnecessary fallbacks and Q/A degradation. Mitigation: conservative thresholds and backoff, A/B compare quality scores.
Risk: Telemetry noise leads to oscillation. Mitigation: exponential smoothing + minimum hold time before policy changes.
Risk: Interactions with existing autoscaler. Mitigation: coordination with Autoscale team; orchestrator only suggests, autoscaler retains final decision during initial rollout.
